title: Shiraishi An — The Time Has Come〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What time is it...? Whoa...
It's already one in the morning...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I actually sent that message...
I really told Kohane to meet me at Vivid Street at eight tomorrow morning.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(What am I doing? I haven't been able to stop looking at my messages...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to sleep since I have to get up early for tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I thought I was ready for it, but I feel so nervous.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Why am I this spineless...?
*Sigh*
And so unbelievably lame...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But if I don't buck up, I won't actually be able to face Kohane tomorrow...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I should listen to some music.
A song that'll pump me up...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
I'll start playing it now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's it...
I'll listen to the song Toya wrote!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... It should be somewhere around... Aha!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah...
This really does give you a nice boost of encouragement.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This song encompasses all of our thoughts and feelings...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (All the hard work we've been putting in.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I'm still scared of battling against Kohane. I'm afraid of showing her who I really am.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Every time she reaches a new level, I hesitate to congratulate her. I can never feel completely happy.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've been so afraid of how high she's going to go...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I thought practicing like crazy would help shake this feeling. I believed that was the only way...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (That fear is what brought me to this point. I'm sitting here right now because of it.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing me this far.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But we won't be able to surpass RAD WEEKEND if I don't do this...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to deal with these feelings and say goodbye to the lame, old me once and for all.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I know I still have a lot to learn...but I still want to work toward that goal together!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I didn't think that for a second...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I... I'll believe in you, An!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I was pretty afraid of singing all by myself, but I'm so glad that I did... Thanks for believing in me, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I need to get over my fears and move forward!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I want to be able to look Kohane in the eye. And in order to do that...)
